newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka says over 200 killed in battle.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka says over 200 killed in battle.

text.p: Over 200 soldiers and rebels were killed in the latest battle in northern Sri Lanka, where troops are fighting Tamil Tiger separatists in an attempt to open a key highway, the Defence Ministry said on Wednesday.

"Four officers and 60 soldiers were killed in action and 68 soldiers were wounded in the confrontation," a Defence Ministry statement said. "According to ground troops, over 150 terrorists were killed and a large number injured."
A colonel, commander of an infantry battalion, was among the officers killed, the statement said.
Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels launched a major counter-attack on military positions in the northern separatist controlled Wanni region late on Tuesday, their second in two weeks.

The statement said more than 1,000 rebels attacked the military's artillery and mortar positions near Periyamadu, north of the government-held town of Vavuniya, which lies some 220 km (135 miles) north of the capital Colombo.

The LTTE are fighting for a separate homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east. The government says more than 50,000 people have been killed in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE say the toll is higher.
